description: This Java source file defines the class 'FileBasedAuthenticationService', which provides an implementation of an authentication service based on reading user and role authorities from a JSON configuration file. It extends an abstract authentication service, loads permissions during startup, and verifies user credentials, generating tokens for authenticated users.

classes.name: FileBasedAuthenticationService
classes.description: A service class implementing authentication logic based on JSON-configured user and role authorities. It loads permissions from a resource file, parses roles and users, and verifies user credentials, issuing tokens.

methods.name: setConfig
methods.description: Sets the specific configuration for this authentication service.

methods.name: setTokenFactory
methods.description: Injects the token factory used for creating authentication tokens.

methods.name: doStart
methods.description: Initializes the service, loads permissions from the configuration resource.

methods.name: loadPermissions
methods.description: Loads user and role permissions from the specified resource path.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Reads content from a resource into a StringBuilder.

methods.name: parsePermissions
methods.description: Parses permissions JSON object to load roles and users.

methods.name: parseRoles
methods.description: Parses role definitions from JSON and populates the roles map.

methods.name: parseUsers
methods.description: Parses user definitions from JSON and populates the users map.

methods.name: getUser
methods.description: Retrieves user JSON object based on username and mechanism.

methods.name: getAuthorities
methods.description: Constructs authorities for a user based on role mappings.

methods.name: toAuthorities
methods.description: Converts JSON array of authorities into Authorities object.

methods.name: hasAuthority
methods.description: Checks if a user has a specific authority role.

methods.name: isAuthorizedToImpersonate
methods.description: Checks if user has impersonation authority.

methods.name: verifyPlain
methods.description: Verifies username and password for a plain authentication, and issues token on success.

methods.name: verifyExternal
methods.description: Verifies external authentication based on subject DN, and issues token on success.

methods.name: verify
methods.description: Common logic for finalizing authentication, generating token and constructing HonoUser.
